tagline: Run your people without the chaos.
brief: HR and workforce operations software: attendance, payroll, leave, onboarding and chat in one system. Sold as a complete product with its full source code, for teams that want to own it. It should feel calm, sharp, human and a little playful, never corporate-stiff.
criteria: Success: reads as a person and as dc, works at 16 px and in one colour, uses only black, white and the existing lime, and is distinct from the usual blue HR marks.

concepts.name: The dc person
concepts.idea: A person in a collar and tie stands on dc: the d and c share one stroke, and the person is the d's stem.
rationale: The d and c share a stroke, so the name is one shape
The person is the employee the software exists for
Heavier small-size cut keeps it clear at 16 px

recommendation: The dc person: it says employee, name and ownership in one mark, in the three colours the site already uses.
next_steps: Hand the files to design and print
